headline: Digital Marketing Assistant

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Business Administration, major in Marketing Management
notes: Best in marketing plan, graduating class of 2025

summary: Digital marketing assistant with a year of experience running social media and email for a tuna products company. I plan and post content, set up Facebook ad campaigns, send monthly Mailchimp newsletters and read the Google Analytics numbers behind them. I want to take on bigger campaigns and more of the strategy.

projects.name: Marketing plan for a Sarangani resort

projects.name: Barangay tourism page
projects.description: Set up and ran a Facebook page promoting a coastal barangay's festival, growing it to 4,000 followers.

skills: Social media marketing and content calendars
Content writing for posts and newsletters
